provenance.note: One 7 iron: five shots near 150 and a 22-yard top, which the automatic mishit rule holds out of the carry, so the club's carry dispersion counts 5 of its 6 shots while its ball-speed baseline counts all 6. No topic exists, for club-mixed-bag's reason. Recorded by Rust, not worked: no hand and no Python stands behind this case (oracle rust, the M29 plan's D9), so what it pins is stability, the tool's answer over a tree frozen Python answered every other tool over.
